dialogues.jp:
今日の体育はバスケ。体育館中に、重いボール
の弾む音が響いている。
dialogues.en:
Today's PE class was basketball. The thumping sound of heavy
balls bouncing on the floor was heard throughout the gym.
dialogues.text:
Today's PE class was basketball. The thumping sound of heavy
balls bouncing on the floor was heard throughout the gym.

dialogues.jp:
「全員が一斉にドリブルの練習をすると、滅茶
　苦茶うるさいんだよな」
dialogues.en:
"If the entire class practiced dribbling simultaneously, it
would make a horrendous noise..."
dialogues.text:
"If the entire class practiced dribbling simultaneously, it
would make a horrendous noise..."

dialogues.jp: 呟きながら、何度か体育館の横を往復する。
dialogues.en:
I muttered under my breath, as I continued doing rounds
around the gymnasium.
dialogues.text:
I muttered under my breath, as I continued doing rounds
around the gymnasium.

dialogues.jp:
バスケは試合じゃなきゃ、そんなに走らないか
ら、楽でいい。
dialogues.en:
There wasn't any match scheduled, so there was no need to
hurry.
dialogues.text:
There wasn't any match scheduled, so there was no need to
hurry.

dialogues.jp: （シュート練習でも、息なんかあがらないしな）
dialogues.en: "(Maybe some shooting practice will get my lungs going...)"
dialogues.text: "(Maybe some shooting practice will get my lungs going...)"

dialogues.jp: 後はつき指にさえ気をつければ……。
dialogues.en: I steady my grip and assume a shooting stance...
dialogues.text: I steady my grip and assume a shooting stance...

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、ナイスシュート――と。

試合でもなければ、運動量がそんなに多いわけ
でも無いバスケは、ドリブルの騒音にさえ気に
しなければ、かったるさは少ない。
dialogues.en:
With no match on, the entire class concentrated mostly on
ball work, causing constant dribbling noises to echo across
the gymnasium.
dialogues.text:
With no match on, the entire class concentrated mostly on
ball work, causing constant dribbling noises to echo across
the gymnasium.

dialogues.jp: 後はまあ、つき指に気をつけて、と。
dialogues.en: After which, it was time to practice shooting...
dialogues.text: After which, it was time to practice shooting...
